notes.title: Update 0.8.232 - Fixes, improvements and a new item
notes.notes:
Included new item.
 Included new NPCs.
 Fixes in some scenarios and some reworks incoming.
 Improved cat interaction.
 Improved UI overall look and performance.
 Included important feedback to the player when the camera is in fixed mode.
 Included a developer console.


There is still a lot of work to do, all items are not complete and are still being implemented.
